title: Mason (Rajmistri)
description: Lay bricks and concrete blocks for a four-storey residential building under construction. Daily work includes mixing mortar, building walls to the marked line and level, plastering finished walls and fixing small defects. You will work with two helpers and report to the site supervisor. Lunch and tea are provided on site. Work runs Sunday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, with occasional Saturday overtime paid separately. Previous mason experience is required.
address: Near Shantinagar Gate, New Baneshwor, Kathmandu (approximate)

title: House Wiring Electrician
description: Install and repair electrical wiring in homes and small shops across Kathmandu Valley. You will run conduit, fit switches, sockets and MCB boards, test circuits and find faults in existing installations. The team visits two or three sites per day, so you must be comfortable on a motorbike or public transport. CTEVT or on-the-job training is welcome but a certificate is not mandatory. Company provides safety gloves and a tool kit. Monthly salary with travel allowance.
address: Near Koteshwor Chowk, Araniko Highway, Kathmandu (approximate)
requirements: Able to travel to client sites

title: Plumbing Assistant
description: Assist a senior plumber in fitting water pipes, bathroom fixtures, tanks and drainage lines in new apartments and renovated homes. You will carry materials, cut and thread pipes, help install taps and toilets, and clean the work area after every job. No experience is needed because the senior plumber trains you on the job. After six months of good work, you can move to an independent plumber role with higher pay. Six working days a week.
address: Kalanki Chowk, Kalanki-Naya Bazaar Road, Kathmandu (approximate)

title: Carpenter (Furniture and Doors)
description: Make and fit wooden doors, windows, wardrobes and kitchen cabinets in our workshop and at client homes. A normal day includes measuring, cutting sal and sisau wood, joining, sanding and polishing, then installing finished pieces on site. You should be able to follow a drawing or the owner's instructions with little supervision. Work is mostly in the workshop with some site visits. Daily wage is paid every Saturday, and extra pay is given for site installation days.
address: Near Gongabu Bus Park, Ring Road, Kathmandu (approximate)
requirements: Can use power saw and drill safely

title: Construction Site Helper
description: Support masons, bar-benders and carpenters on a residential building site. Daily tasks include carrying cement bags, bricks and sand, mixing concrete by hand or with a small mixer, cleaning the work area and shifting scaffolding. Helmets and boots are provided. No experience is required, and hardworking helpers are often promoted to assistant mason with higher pay. Work starts at 8 AM and ends at 5 PM with a one-hour lunch break. Payment is made weekly.

title: Painting Worker
description: Paint interior and exterior walls of houses, shops and guest houses. You will scrape old paint, apply putty, sand surfaces, then apply primer and two coats of emulsion or enamel. Teams of three or four work together and move to a new site every one to two weeks. Neat finishing and careful use of masking tape are important. Paint, brushes and rollers are supplied by the company. Overtime is available during the Tihar and wedding seasons.
address: Near Suryabinayak Road, Bhaktapur Municipality, Bhaktapur (approximate)
requirements: Willing to travel within the valley

title: Tile Worker
description: Fit floor and bathroom wall tiles in new houses and shops. You will prepare the surface, spread cement or adhesive, set tiles with even spacing, cut tiles around corners and pipes, and finish with grout. Accuracy and levelling matter because customers check for gaps. The company supplies tile cutters and spacers, and workers bring their own trowel and hammer. Payment is per working day, with a small bonus when a site is finished before the promised date.

title: Welder and Steel Fabricator
description: Make window grills, gates, staircase railings and steel shutters in a busy workshop. You will cut steel sections, weld joints, grind rough edges and prepare pieces for painting. About half of the orders are installed at customer homes, so you may join the installation team. Experience with arc welding is required. The workshop provides welding machines, helmets and gloves. Salary is monthly, with overtime paid at a fixed hourly rate.
address: Near Jawalakhel Chowk, Ring Road, Lalitpur (approximate)

title: Rod Binder (Rebar Fitter)
description: Cut, bend and tie steel reinforcement rods for columns, beams and slabs on a commercial building project. You will follow the site engineer's bar bending schedule, set rods at the right spacing and tie them with binding wire so they stay in place during concreting. The work involves climbing and standing for long hours. Safety harnesses and helmets are provided. Rod binders with experience can lead a small group and earn higher daily pay.

title: POP and Plaster Worker
description: Plaster walls and fit decorative POP ceilings in new apartments and offices. You will mix plaster, apply it to even thickness, finish corners and ceiling borders and fix small cracks. The team usually works on two flats at a time, so speed and neat finishing are both important. Tools and materials are provided. Work is from 8 AM to 5 PM on weekdays and half a day on Saturday, paid daily or weekly as you prefer.
address: Near Chabahil Chowk, Ghattekulo Road, Kathmandu (approximate)
experience: 1+ year of plastering or POP experience

title: Delivery Rider (Own Bike)
description: Deliver parcels and shop orders to homes and offices in the western Kathmandu area. You will collect packages from the hub, plan the order of deliveries, collect cash on delivery and return the money to the cashier each evening. A smartphone with data is needed to use the delivery app. Monthly pay includes a fuel allowance, plus a bonus for completing more than 25 deliveries a day. Working hours are 9 AM to 6 PM, six days a week.

title: Warehouse Assistant
description: Receive goods from trucks, check them against the delivery slip, sort items by shelf and keep the warehouse tidy. Daily tasks include counting boxes, labelling shelves, helping the storekeeper record stock in a register and loading packed orders onto vans. No experience is needed because training is given in the first week. The warehouse works six days a week from 9 AM to 6 PM. Tea and lunch are provided, and overtime is paid on busy days.

title: Parcel Courier
description: Pick up parcels from small online sellers and deliver them to customers in Maharajgunj, Budhanilkantha and nearby areas. You will scan or record each parcel, call the customer before arriving, collect payment where needed and mark each parcel as delivered. Customer-friendly behaviour matters, because failed deliveries cost the company. A fuel allowance is paid on top of the monthly salary. Mornings are for pickups, afternoons are for deliveries.
address: Near Maharajgunj Chowk, Ring Road, Kathmandu (approximate)

title: Packing Worker
description: Pack snacks, noodles and dry food into boxes and cartons in a small food distribution unit. You will weigh items, seal packets, stick labels with batch and expiry dates and stack finished cartons for dispatch. Gloves and hair caps are provided and must be worn at all times. No experience is required. Standing for long periods is part of the job. Shift is 8 AM to 4 PM, six days a week, and a free lunch is included.

title: Loading and Unloading Assistant
description: Load and unload trucks and mini-trucks carrying vegetables, grain, building supplies and household goods at the Gongabu cargo area. You will carry sacks and cartons, stack them safely and help the driver tie down loads. The work is physically heavy, and shifts depend on truck arrivals, often starting at 6 AM. Payment is given at the end of each working day, and extra is added for night or holiday loading.
requirements: Able to work in early mornings

title: Inventory Assistant
description: Keep track of stock in a wholesale store selling rice, oil, spices and household goods. You will count items, record stock coming in and going out in a notebook or simple spreadsheet, check expiry dates and tell the owner when items run low. You will also help pack orders for retail customers. Stockroom experience is helpful but not required. Working hours are 9 AM to 6 PM, with Saturday off.
address: Near Satdobato Chowk, Ring Road, Lalitpur (approximate)

title: Evening Food Delivery Rider
description: Deliver hot food from restaurants in Pulchowk, Jawalakhel and Kupondole to customers' doors during evening hours. You choose your shifts from a weekly schedule. Hourly pay is paid for the hours you are online, with a bonus per delivery during dinner rush. Students and people with a daytime job are welcome. You need your own motorbike, helmet and a smartphone with mobile data. Fuel support is given on completed orders.

title: Delivery Van Helper
description: Ride in a delivery van with the driver and hand over fruit, vegetables and packaged food to hotels, canteens and shops. You will load the van at 6 AM, check each order against the list, carry boxes inside and collect signed delivery slips. You also help the driver with parking and unloading. The job is physically active and starts early, finishing around 2 PM. Meals during the shift are provided, and a monthly attendance bonus is paid.

title: Dispatch Sorting Assistant
description: Sort incoming parcels by delivery area in a small logistics hub, so riders can leave quickly each morning. You will scan or write parcel codes, put each parcel into the right area bag, check for damaged packaging and hand bags to riders. Speed and accuracy matter because wrong sorting causes late deliveries. Training is given on the first day. Shift is 7 AM to 3 PM, and you get one weekly day off.
requirements: Can read Nepali and basic English

title: Dairy Distribution Helper
description: Help load milk and curd crates onto a distribution vehicle and deliver them to small shops and tea stalls in Suryabinayak, Thimi and Bhaktapur. You will check crates against the order sheet, handle chilled products carefully, collect payments and return empty crates to the depot. The shift starts at 5 AM and finishes by 1 PM, so this suits early risers. Tea is provided each morning and a festival bonus is given at Dashain.

title: Waiter / Waitress
description: Serve food and drinks to tourists and local guests at a busy Thamel restaurant. You will take orders, explain the menu in simple English, carry plates, clear tables and handle bills with the cashier. Evening shifts are busiest, so you must stay calm under pressure. Uniform and daily meals are provided. Tips are shared among staff and can add to your pay. Basic spoken English is helpful but training is available.

title: Barista
description: Prepare espresso drinks, tea and cold coffee for visitors and local customers near Boudha. You will grind and tune coffee, steam milk, keep the bar clean, restock cups and syrups and take payments. A small cafe means you also help with simple snacks and cleaning. Previous cafe experience is preferred, but a motivated beginner can be trained. Shifts are either 7 AM to 3 PM or 12 PM to 8 PM.

title: Kitchen Helper
description: Support the head cook in a small restaurant serving momo and thali sets. You will wash and cut vegetables, prepare fillings, clean utensils, keep the kitchen floor dry and help with packing takeaway orders. No experience is required, and the cook will teach you simple cooking tasks over time. Working hours are 9 AM to 7 PM with a rest break in the afternoon. Two meals a day are included in your pay.
requirements: Able to stand for long hours

title: Housekeeping Staff
description: Clean and prepare guest rooms in a 20-room guest house. You will change linen, make beds, dust, mop floors, clean bathrooms, restock toiletries and report any damage or lost items. A room checklist guides you, and the supervisor inspects after cleaning. The job needs honesty because guests leave valuables in rooms. Shifts are 7 AM to 4 PM. Rooms are usually cleaned between 10 AM and 2 PM, with lighter duties otherwise.

title: Restaurant Assistant
description: Work in a busy student restaurant near the campus. You will serve dal bhat sets and snacks, refill water jugs, clear and wipe tables, wash plates when needed and help the cashier at peak times. Lunch is the busiest period, so the shift is 10 AM to 8 PM with a short afternoon break. You will eat your meals at the restaurant. Experience is not needed, and the owner trains new staff in the first week.

title: Hotel Cleaner
description: Keep the lobby, stairways, courtyard and public bathrooms of a small heritage hotel clean. You will sweep and mop floors, polish brass and wood fixtures, empty bins and wash windows. Cleaning supplies, gloves and uniform are provided. The hotel has traditional Newari architecture, so careful handling of wood carvings is important. Shift is 6 AM to 2 PM with a half-day on Saturday. Local residents of Bhaktapur are preferred.
requirements: Comfortable working in an old building

title: Momo Maker
description: Prepare fresh momo for a popular local eatery. You will roll dough, fill, fold and steam or fry momo in large batches, prepare achar and keep the work counter clean. Speed and neat folding are essential because customers order by the plate all day. You should know both steamed and fried styles. Shift is 8 AM to 6 PM, and daily meals are provided. Extra pay is offered if you teach new helpers.
requirements: Knowledge of buff and veg fillings

title: Banquet Server
description: Serve food at weddings, bratabandha and other large events at a party palace. You will set tables, lay plates, serve dishes, refill water and clear tables after meals. Work is event-based, so you are called when bookings are confirmed, often on weekends and in the wedding season. A day shift is 2 PM to 11 PM. Payment is made in cash at the end of each event day. Dinner is provided to all staff.

title: Sweet Shop Helper
description: Assist the head sweet maker in preparing jalebi, laddu, barfi and sel roti. You will measure ingredients, stir large pans, shape sweets, fry batches and pack finished boxes for shop sales and festival orders. The kitchen starts at 5 AM and is hot, so stamina is needed. Festival months such as Dashain and Tihar are very busy and bring overtime pay. You can grow into a sweet maker role.

title: Laundry Attendant
description: Wash, dry, iron and fold bed sheets, towels and uniforms for a mid-sized hotel. You will sort linen by type, run washing and drying machines, iron flat sheets, fold stock and deliver clean linen to housekeeping. You will also handle some guest laundry bags with care. The work is physical and warm, so you will need to be comfortable standing for long periods. Shift is 7 AM to 4 PM with weekly rotation of off days.
address: Near Bijuli Bazaar, New Baneshwor, Kathmandu (approximate)

title: Shop Assistant
description: Help customers in a neighbourhood grocery shop selling rice, oil, snacks, soap and daily goods. You will pick items from shelves, weigh loose goods, bill purchases, refill shelves and keep the shop tidy. You will learn product prices and where items are kept. Regular customers are common, so friendliness matters. The shop opens at 7 AM and closes at 8 PM, with shifts shared between two assistants. Weekly day off is on Saturday.

title: Cashier
description: Handle billing at a busy supermarket counter. You will scan items, collect cash and eSewa or Fonepay payments, give correct change, pack bags and close the counter at the end of the shift with the supervisor. Accuracy matters because cash differences are checked daily. Training on the billing software is given. Basic maths and honesty are essential. Shifts are 9 AM to 6 PM or 12 PM to 9 PM on rotation.

title: Supermarket Floor Staff
description: Keep supermarket shelves full, neat and correctly priced. You will unpack goods from cartons, place them on shelves with the oldest items in front, check expiry dates, answer customer questions on where items are and clean spills. You will also help move heavy stock from the back store. Saturday is the busiest day, so weekend work is expected. Staff uniform is provided, and a monthly staff shopping discount is available.

title: Handicraft Salesperson
description: Sell singing bowls, pashmina, thangka paintings and other handicrafts to tourists. You will greet visitors, explain what each item is made of, show how it is used, agree fair prices within the owner's limits and pack purchases for travel. Basic English and a friendly approach matter most. The monthly salary is combined with a sales commission, which can add 3,000 to 8,000 rupees in the tourist season. Shop hours are 9 AM to 8 PM.

title: Stock Handler
description: Receive wholesale goods such as biscuits, noodles, soap and drinks, count cartons against the invoice and stack them in the correct store rows. When shopkeepers order, you pick and load items onto their vehicles. You will report damaged goods to the manager and help with monthly stock counting. The job involves daily lifting, so physical fitness is needed. Work hours are 8 AM to 5 PM, six days a week, with overtime during festival stocking.

title: Clothing Store Assistant
description: Assist shoppers in a clothing store that sells jeans, kurtas, tops and winter wear. You will suggest sizes and styles, show items from the rack, keep displays tidy, fold returned clothes and help bill purchases. Festival seasons bring larger crowds, so you must stay patient and polite. The shop works 10 AM to 8 PM with a lunch break, and a monthly sales bonus is shared among staff.
requirements: Good communication in Nepali and Hindi

title: Hardware and Paint Shop Salesperson
description: Sell nuts, bolts, pipes, cement, tools and paint to builders and householders. You will understand what customers need for their job, suggest the right product, measure and cut pipes or wire, mix paint using the tinting machine and prepare bills. Knowledge of building materials is a big advantage. You will also unload stock and keep the shop organised. Working hours are 8 AM to 7 PM, and Saturday is a half day.
experience: 1+ year in a hardware or building material shop

title: Bakery Counter Assistant
description: Serve customers at the counter of a bakery that sells local juju dhau, cakes, bread and sweets near Durbar Square. You will pack boxes, explain products to tourists, take payments and keep the display clean. Weekends and festival days are busy. Basic English is helpful but not required. Shift is 8 AM to 7 PM. A free tea and one meal are provided each day, and you can buy bakery items at staff discount.

title: Fruit and Vegetable Shop Attendant
description: Run the daily sale of fresh vegetables and fruit. You will help unload the morning delivery, sort produce, remove spoiled items, weigh purchases and collect payment. You will arrange the display each morning to look fresh and clean. Freshness and fair weights keep regular customers returning. The shop opens at 6 AM and closes at 7 PM, with a rest break in the afternoon. A small monthly bonus is given for low wastage.

title: Footwear Store Salesperson
description: Sell shoes, sandals and sports footwear to families and students. You will measure feet, bring different sizes, explain the difference between brands and materials, bill the sale and put returned pairs back in order. You will also arrange new stock and prepare window displays. The store is busiest at Dashain and in the school season. Work hours are 10 AM to 8 PM, and the shop closes one weekday for rest.

title: Stone Mason
description: Build retaining walls, boundary walls and house foundations using local stone. You will shape stones with chisel and hammer, set them in mortar, check alignment with a string line and fill gaps neatly. Work is mostly outdoors around Banepa and nearby villages, so you should be comfortable in sun and rain. A helper is provided to carry stones. Pay is daily, collected each Saturday, and extra is paid for walls above two metres in height.

title: Roofing Sheet Worker
description: Fit zinc and colour-coated roofing sheets on houses, godowns and small factories. You will measure and cut sheets, fix them to steel or wooden frames with screws, seal joints against rain and check for leaks. Most work is on rooftops, so a safety harness is provided and its use is compulsory. Teams of four finish one roof in two to four days. Overtime is paid when a job must be done before monsoon rain.

title: Drain and Pavement Worker
description: Dig, clear and build roadside drains and lay paving stones for lanes and compounds around Budhanilkantha. Daily tasks include digging trenches, mixing mortar, setting stones in a straight line and levelling the surface. The work is physically heavy and outdoors. No experience is needed because the foreman shows you each step. Tools are provided by the contractor. Payment is made weekly, and consistent workers are offered steady work through the dry season.

title: Glass and Aluminium Fitter
description: Measure, cut and install aluminium windows, sliding doors, glass partitions and shop-front glass. A typical day involves taking measurements at a client site, assembling frames in the workshop, cutting glass to size and fixing everything with silicone and screws. Handling large glass sheets safely requires teamwork and patience. Gloves and safety shoes are provided. Monthly salary is paid with an extra allowance for out-of-valley site work.
requirements: Works at height with a harness

title: Wood Polish Worker
description: Finish wooden doors, beds, cupboards and tables before delivery to customers. You will sand the surface smooth, fill small holes, apply stain, polish or varnish with brush or spray gun and let each coat dry before the next. Good finishing makes the furniture look expensive, so patience matters. The workshop has good ventilation, and masks and gloves are provided. Work is Sunday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, with daily payment.

title: Bricklayer Helper
description: Support masons on a housing project by carrying bricks, mixing mortar, filling water containers and cleaning the work area. You will also shift scaffolding poles and pass materials to workers on upper floors. This is a good starting job for someone new to construction, and helpers who learn quickly can move up to assistant mason. Work is 8 AM to 5 PM with a one-hour lunch break. Water and basic first aid are available on site.

title: Concrete Mixer Operator
description: Run a concrete mixer and block-making machine at a small plant in Thimi. You will load cement, sand and aggregate in the correct ratio, start and stop the mixer, pour concrete into moulds or trucks and clean the machine at the end of each day. Basic knowledge of mix proportions is needed. Safety shoes, mask and gloves are provided. Working hours are 8 AM to 5 PM, six days a week, and monthly salary is paid on the first week of each month.

title: Solar Heater Installer Helper
description: Assist technicians in installing solar water heaters on house and hotel rooftops. You will carry panels and tanks to the roof, help fix stands, connect pipes, test for leaks and clean the work area. After training, you can learn to do the installation independently. The job involves climbing and some heavy lifting, but safety belts and gloves are provided. Work is six days a week with occasional Saturday overtime.

title: Water Tank Cleaning Worker
description: Clean underground and rooftop water tanks in homes, apartments and offices. You will drain tanks, scrub walls, remove sediment, rinse with clean water and treat with approved disinfectant before refilling. Teams of two or three visit two or three buildings a day. Rubber boots, gloves and masks are provided. Work is physical and sometimes in tight spaces. Daily wages are paid on the same day, with extra pay for large apartment tanks.

title: Granite and Marble Polisher
description: Grind and polish granite and marble floors, kitchen tops and staircases in new houses and showrooms. You will operate a polishing machine, change grinding heads, fill small cracks and finish the shine with polishing powder. Dust is common, so masks and goggles are provided and must be worn. You will travel in the company pickup to sites around Bhaktapur and Kathmandu. Daily wage is paid weekly, with overtime for night-time finishing before handover.

title: Gas Cylinder Delivery Helper
description: Load and deliver cooking gas cylinders to homes, hotels and restaurants around Boudha and Jorpati. You will ride in the delivery truck, check each cylinder for leaks, carry it to the kitchen, replace empty ones and collect payment and receipts. The work is physical and shifts start at 6 AM. Safety rules are taught on the first day. Monthly salary includes a bonus for customers served and a festival allowance at Dashain.

title: Newspaper and Magazine Distributor
description: Deliver daily newspapers and weekly magazines to homes, offices and embassies near Lazimpat before breakfast. You will collect bundles from the distribution point at 4:30 AM, sort them by route, ride to each address and collect subscription fees at month-end. The route takes about three hours. Ideal for students or people with an afternoon job. Monthly pay includes a small bonus for zero missed deliveries.

title: Water Jar Delivery Rider
description: Deliver 20-litre drinking water jars to homes and offices around Budhanilkantha and Kapan using a delivery vehicle. You will load jars, carry them to upper floors when needed, collect empty ones and record deliveries in a book. Regular customers rely on you, so punctuality is important. Hours are 7 AM to 4 PM with a lunch break. Pay is monthly with a bonus for every jar delivered above the daily target.
requirements: Valid two-wheeler or light vehicle licence

title: Pharmacy Delivery Rider
description: Deliver medicines and health items from partner pharmacies to patients and families, mainly near the teaching hospital area. You will pick up sealed packages, check the address, deliver quickly and carefully, and collect payment if needed. You must never open packages. Timely delivery is important, especially for patients waiting at home or hospital. Fuel allowance is added to your monthly salary, and some evening shifts are available.

title: Tempo Helper
description: Ride with the driver of a small goods vehicle carrying vegetables, building supplies and household goods between Banepa, Dhulikhel and Kathmandu. You will load and unload items, count goods against the slip, tie ropes and help the driver check the load. Some days start before dawn. The work is physical and requires patience in traffic. Meals are provided during trips, and the company gives a small bonus for long-distance days.

title: Cold Storage Assistant
description: Receive, store and release frozen and chilled goods such as meat, dairy and vegetables in a small cold storage. You will check temperature gauges, move boxes with a hand trolley, record every item that comes in or out and keep floors dry. Warm jackets and gloves are provided. Working in the cold requires breaks, and the supervisor will rotate duties. Shift is 8 AM to 5 PM, six days a week.

title: Garment Packing Worker
description: Fold, tag and pack finished garments such as T-shirts, sweaters and scarves into cartons for export or local shops. You will check each piece for loose threads, attach price tags, count items per carton and seal and label boxes. Speed and neat handling are important because buyers inspect the packing. Training takes two days. Shift is 9 AM to 6 PM with a lunch break. Overtime is paid when shipments are urgent.

title: Mail and Parcel Sorter
description: Sort letters, documents and small parcels by area at a courier branch and hand them to delivery staff. You will check addresses, assign each item to the right route bag, update delivery sheets and call customers when an address is unclear. The job needs attention to detail but no special education. Shift is 8 AM to 5 PM, with extra hours before Dashain and Tihar. Training is provided on the first day.

title: Vegetable Market Porter
description: Carry sacks and crates of vegetables from incoming trucks to shop stalls, and help traders load purchases for restaurants and hotels. You will lift, stack and weigh produce when required. Work starts around 5 AM when the early deliveries arrive and usually ends by noon. Payment is made in cash each day, depending on the number of loads carried. It is a physically demanding job suited to strong workers.

title: E-commerce Returns Handler
description: Handle returned products from online shoppers in a small fulfilment hub. You will open returned parcels, check items against the order, separate damaged goods, repack good items and scan them back into stock. You will also prepare faulty items for return to suppliers. Clear records are important to avoid disputes. Shifts are 10 AM to 7 PM with a one-hour break, and overtime is available during sales seasons.

title: Tea Shop Helper
description: Help make tea, serve samosas and sel roti, wash glasses and clean tables at a busy roadside tea shop. Regular customers include office workers, drivers and temple visitors. You will learn to prepare milk tea and black tea in large pots and manage orders during morning rush. The shop opens at 6 AM and closes at 7 PM with an afternoon break. Meals are provided, and tips are shared fairly.

title: Chef Assistant
description: Work under the head chef at a restaurant popular with embassy staff and families. You will prepare vegetables, marinate meats, make sauces, cook simple dishes during rush hour and keep your station clean. Plating is checked by the chef, so neatness matters. Kitchen experience is required, but formal culinary training is not. Shifts alternate between 8 AM to 4 PM and 1 PM to 10 PM. Staff meals are provided.

title: Dishwasher
description: Wash plates, glasses, pans and kitchen tools at a busy fast food restaurant. You will scrub and rinse using the dishwashing sink, keep clean utensils organised, empty kitchen waste and mop the floor at closing time. Evenings and weekends are the busiest. Rubber gloves and an apron are provided. This is a good starting point for kitchen work, and good performers can move to kitchen helper roles. Meals are provided during shifts.

title: Hotel Bellboy
description: Welcome guests at the hotel entrance, carry their bags to rooms, explain basic facilities and run small errands inside the hotel. You will also help with taxi calls and keep the lobby tidy. Tourists often give tips, which are shared by the team. Basic English or Hindi is helpful for the job. Shifts rotate between morning and evening. Uniform and meals are provided, and training is given in guest manners.

title: Room Service Attendant
description: Deliver food, drinks and laundry to guests in their rooms in a small boutique hotel. You will take orders by phone, check them with the kitchen, carry trays safely, set up meals in rooms and collect them afterwards. Accuracy and politeness are important for guest satisfaction. Evening shifts are busier. Basic English is needed to understand guests' requests. Meals are provided and a service charge share is included.
experience: 6+ months in a hotel or restaurant

title: Guest House Gardener
description: Look after the garden, lawn, flower beds and vegetable patch of a hill-view guest house. You will water plants, cut grass, remove weeds, prune bushes, prepare compost and help with minor repairs around the property. Fresh vegetables from the garden are used in the kitchen, so organic care is encouraged. Working hours are 6 AM to 2 PM. Free meals and a small staff room are available on request.

title: Sekuwa Griller
description: Grill sekuwa, choila and meat skewers in the evening at a popular local eatery. You will prepare and marinate meat, light charcoal, control the heat, turn skewers and serve hot to waiters. Timing is important because overcooking spoils the taste. The work is hot and busiest at dinner time and weekends. Shift is 2 PM to 10 PM. A staff dinner is included and good grillers can earn a monthly bonus.

title: Canteen Server
description: Serve tea, snacks and rice meals to hospital visitors, patients' families and staff. You will take food orders at the counter, fill plates, clean tables and keep serving areas tidy. Hygiene rules are strict, with hair caps and gloves provided. The canteen opens at 6 AM and closes at 8 PM with split shifts. It is a steady job with a fixed monthly salary and free meals during duty.
address: Near Teaching Hospital Road, Maharajgunj, Kathmandu (approximate)

title: Chowmein Cook
description: Cook chowmein, fried rice and thukpa on a high-flame wok for students and office workers. You will prepare vegetables and sauces, cook dishes in order of arrival and manage the stove in rush hour. Taste and speed should stay consistent throughout the day. Hot working conditions require comfortable clothing and good stamina. Shift is 10 AM to 8 PM with a break, and daily lunch is provided by the owner.
requirements: Can cook 20+ plates in rush hour

title: Guest House Receptionist (Entry Level)
description: Welcome guests, record check-in and check-out details, answer phone calls and give simple directions to nearby places. You will also handle key cards, accept payments and tell housekeeping when rooms are ready. Basic spoken English is required, and training on booking steps is provided. Evening and night shifts alternate with morning shifts. A free room meal and tea are included. This is a good first step towards hotel work.
requirements: Can use a phone and simple booking register

title: Mobile Accessories Seller
description: Sell phone chargers, cases, earphones, power banks and screen protectors in a small shop. You will help customers choose accessories, test items, fit screen protectors, bill purchases and keep the display neat. Knowledge of common phones is useful and will be taught. The shop opens at 9 AM and closes at 8 PM with rotating weekly rest days. Monthly salary comes with a small commission on accessory sales.

title: Cosmetics Shop Assistant
description: Assist customers in selecting skincare, hair care and cosmetic products. You will explain products, arrange shelves, refill stock, check expiry dates and handle billing. You will learn product names and uses through the owner's training. Customers expect polite advice, so patience is important. The shop works 10 AM to 8 PM, with a weekly day off. Staff discounts on products are available after the first month.

title: Stationery Shop Helper
description: Help students and office workers buy notebooks, pens, art supplies and office items. You will find items on shelves, give prices, use the photocopy machine for small orders, bill purchases and restock the shelves. The shop is busiest at the start of school terms and exam seasons. Hours are 8:30 AM to 7:30 PM, and a day off is given weekly. Training on photocopy and printing machines is provided.

title: Gift Shop Attendant
description: Assist tourists and local visitors in a gift shop selling pottery, woodcarving and souvenirs. You will greet customers, explain items, wrap gifts and bill purchases. Busy tourist days are the weekends and festival times. Good manners and basic English help you earn a commission on sales. Shop hours are 9 AM to 7 PM. You will also keep the shelves clean and refill stock from the store room.

title: Meat Shop Helper
description: Help the butcher cut, clean and pack meat for regular customers and small restaurants. You will weigh pieces, clean the counters, keep the cold box tidy and bill customers. Strict hygiene is necessary, with gloves and aprons always worn. The shop starts at 6 AM and runs till 7 PM, with the afternoon slow. A small bonus is paid at festival times when sales are highest.

title: Dairy Booth Seller
description: Sell milk, curd, ghee and cheese from a small dairy booth. You will weigh or measure items, pack them in bags or bottles, collect payments and keep the fridge organised. Fresh stock is received early each morning, so you will help unload and arrange it. The booth opens at 6 AM and closes at 7 PM with a long afternoon break. Daily milk is offered to staff at a discount.
address: Near Banepa Bus Park, Banepa, Kavrepalanchok (approximate)

title: Furniture Showroom Assistant
description: Help customers explore beds, sofas, wardrobes and dining tables. You will explain materials and sizes, show finishes, take delivery details, keep the showroom clean and help arrange delivery. You will also help staff move furniture within the showroom. Weekends bring many families, so patience is important. Showroom hours are 10 AM to 7 PM. A monthly commission is paid on top of salary for completed sales.

title: Pharmacy Counter Helper
description: Support the licensed pharmacist by arranging medicines, bringing items from shelves, packing sold products and billing. You will check expiry dates, restock supplies and keep counters clean. You are not allowed to give medical advice or prescribe medicines. Accuracy is crucial because a wrong item could harm a customer. Training on labels and storage is provided. Shifts rotate between 8 AM to 4 PM and 12 PM to 9 PM.

title: Winter Clothes Stall Seller
description: Sell jackets, woollen caps, gloves and sweaters at a busy roadside stall during the cold season. You will show items, size customers, negotiate prices within the owner's range and collect payment. You will also set up and close the stall each day. This is a seasonal job lasting through winter, and a sales commission is added to your fixed monthly pay. Stall works 9 AM to 7 PM.

title: Sports Goods Store Assistant
description: Help students and local clubs choose footballs, badminton rackets, cricket gear, jerseys and gym items. You will explain the differences between products, update the shelves, restock after deliveries and bill customers. Busy periods are school sports seasons and festival tournaments. Hours are 10 AM to 8 PM with one weekly day off. A commission applies on bulk sales to schools and clubs.
